TaskDescription: Approach-avoidance decision game (neurogame.ucsf.edu): per trial a reward offer (treasures) and a punishment offer (bombs); approach or avoid by button press within 6 s.
DerivativeDescription: Authors' high-frequency activity (70-150 Hz), aligned to undocumented alignment 3 (release field trigger(3); not described in README); time zero at sample 5000 of each 12000-sample trial (-4.999 to +7.000 s). Trials back-to-back; values unchanged.
